ANES Time Series Cumulative Data File

ANES Time Series Cumulative Data File

Questions asked in three or more ANES Time Series studies, pooled into one file covering 1948 to 2024, with harmonized codes.

Publisher
American National Election Studies
Dataset
https://electionstudies.org/data-center/anes-time-series-cumulative-data-file/
Terms
https://electionstudies.org/data-center/
ANES's terms of use (Data Center page) say to use the data only for research or statistical purposes, make no use of respondents' identities, and cite ANES data and documentation. The FAQ says ANES public release datasets are public goods and that datasets created from them may be disseminated, with a link back to the original ANES dataset; restricted-use data may not. No login is needed to download. The pages don't address mirroring the original files or codebook, or LLM processing; Allen Downey decided both may ship. Copies of the pages are source anes-terms-pages.
Citation
American National Election Studies. 2026. ANES Time Series Cumulative Data File [dataset and documentation]. February 5, 2026 version. www.electionstudies.org
